column1: # mapping_set_title: "NABON Informatiestandaard borstkanker (2020-11-12) -> ECCDM element crosswalk"

# comment: "Direction: subject (NABON) <predicate> object (ECCDM hub). Terminology layer intentionally deferred (subject_terminology left blank). DURCHSTICH = model CancerConditionAtDiagnosis only. NABON is breast-specific, MDO-report-centric: elements split by pre-/post-operative axis and by imaging modality, hence pervasive n:1 to the hub. Note: NABON has no clean diagnosis/visit/biopsy date (date fields are workflow: aanmelding/MDO) -> hub date elements are gaps."

column12: NABON splittet histolog. Typ nach pre/post-op (486/850) UND nach Modalitaet (Morfologie echo/mammo/MRI 653/655/656). Hub hat 1 Feld -> n:1, Auswahl preoperativ als Erstdiagnose-Aequivalent.
NABON Quadrant-Lokalisation ist feiner (+ Zijde/dataelement-10 fuer Lateralitaet). Hub bodySite = 1 CodeableConcept -> Quadrant+Zijde muessen zusammengefuehrt werden.
NABON splittet Graderung nach invasief/DCIS (17/546) und pre/post-op (560/392). Bloom-Richardson. Hub tumourGradeValue=string, tumourGradeSystem ohne NABON-Aequivalent (Gap).
